Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1479
Claimant:
William Kaiser
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
2023-10-18
Claim received for a rear-end collision in which the insured's vehicle was struck from behind while stopped in traffic.
The claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact will go through the attorney's office.
2023-12-23
Confirmed the driver of the claimed vehicle is named on the policy and that coverage was in force at the time of loss.
Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the policy period.
2023-12-29
Police report obtained. It confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the scene, and the responding officer noted the
impact as minor, with no airbag deployment and both vehicles driven from the scene.
2024-01-23
Reviewed the photographs submitted with the claim. They show the rear bumper damage and the point of contact
consistent with the described impact. A few old scratches on the lower panel may predate this loss and will be noted
separately during the estimate review.
2024-02-03
Vehicle damage has been inspected and the repair scope matches the impact as described. No independent
witnesses have come forward, so the account rests on the parties' statements and the physical evidence.
2024-03-15
Claimant's recorded statement was taken through counsel. The account stayed consistent with the first notice of loss,
though a few small details were added on this call, such as the seating position and the moment of braking.
2024-04-08
Medical recodrs reflect a diagnosis of neck and back strain. Treatment has run somewhat longer than is typical for
this type of injury, and the severity of the claimed injury appears high relative to the low-speed impact. No prior injury
to the same body areas is known from the records received so far.
2024-05-17
Next steps are to request prior medical records, schedule an independent medical review, and obtain a final repair
estimate before any evaluation of the bodily injury portion is made. File remains open pending these items.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
